name: BLACK WOLF MARTIAL ARTS CENTER
address: Al Shahed Tower - 6th floor - Al Khan - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Black Wolf MMA & Boxing is your ultimate destination for fitness and martial arts. We offer a variety of disciplines, including MMA, Muay Thai, Taekwondo, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ), Boxing, Calisthenics, swimming and CrossFit. Our state-of-the-art facility features an MMA cage, a boxing ring, and top-notch equipment tailored to meet the needs of beginners and professionals alike. Whether you're training for competition, improving your fitness, or mastering self-defense, our expert coaches and welcoming community are here to support your journey. Join us and unleash your potential!

reviews.author: Hasan Almouhammadi
reviews.text:
I’ve been training at Black Wolf in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, and I honestly couldn’t recommend it more. The atmosphere is motivating, professional, and welcoming whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced boxer.

The coaches are outstanding — knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in your progress. They pay close attention to technique, conditioning, and discipline, making sure everyone improves safely and effectively. You can tell they’re passionate about boxing and truly care about their members.

The gym itself is clean, well-equipped, and has a strong team spirit. Every session pushes you to be better, both physically and mentally.

If you’re looking for a serious boxing gym with top-level coaching and a supportive environment, Black Wolf is definitely the place to be in Sharjah. 🥊🔥
